claims: BTS is releasing their fifth studio album on March 20, 2026.
BTS's fifth studio album is titled ARIRANG.
The title song of ARIRANG is "Swim".
ARIRANG marks BTS's first full-group comeback in over three years.
BTS's first full-group comeback follows the completion of their mandatory military service.
ARIRANG is BTS's first full-group album since Proof (2022).
A free livestreamed concert is scheduled for March 21, 2026, in Seoul.
BTS's world tour begins on April 9, 2026.
